verdicts.reason: Both rebuild the square as a proper vertical stack with the brand intact, but both break the headline so 'fizz' sits alone on its own line, and both shrink the peach circle into a stub in the corner. A spaces things better: the can sits higher, there is room between the can and the headline, and the CTA has a comfortable bottom margin. B pushes the can down, which leaves a dead gap under the logo, and it jams the CTA against the body copy (about 12px apart) so the bottom feels cramped.
